simulator.note: Boots as the M3329 family (chips/m3329.py, chip ID 0x3101) from its 2 MB ST M29W160ET parallel NOR flash at 0xAFC00000 (its first chunk has BOOTLOADER_CHUNK_ID 0xE3000010 and OEM board name "S1E52-2SR"): the bootloader unpacks maincode V1.07B5* into SDRAM and starts it ("APP  init ok").  PAN_COMMON_0 multiplexes its 4-digit 7-segment front panel through a 74HC164 shift register on CLK = GPIO 0, DATA = GPIO 1 and active-low digit strobes GPIO 2, 3, 5, 6 with segment mapping (4, 6, 1, 2, 3, 5, 0, 7) (hc164_decoder.py: " ON " -> "Strt" -> "noCH"), while OSD_M3327_0 renders its 156-colour 608x430 centered 8 bpp CLUT direct framebuffer window at (56, 73) (0xB80041A0 = 0x0000800F, 0xB80041A4 = 0x80212420, 0xB80041A8 = 0x026001AE, 0xB80041B0 = 0x00380297, 0xB80041B4 = 0x004901F6) showing the "Edit Channel" main menu.

desc: 2 MB ST M29W160ET parallel-NOR JTAG flash dump (1,984 KB file, maincode V1.07B5* dated 2007-06-07) from a BigSat DSR 7035 Plus DVB-S satellite receiver (board S1E52-2SR).

Uses the M3327 direct-window OSD controller (OSD_M3327_0 centered 608x430 window at (56, 73) via 0xB80041B0 / 0xB80041B4) and a 74HC164 shift-register front panel on GPIO 0 / 1 with digit strobes on GPIO 2, 3, 5, 6.
